name: SubscriptionInfo.getCarrierName
author: Identra
description: The name displayed to the user that identifies subscription provider name. This name is the SPN displayed in status bar and many other places. Can't be renamed by the user.

name: SubscriptionInfo.getCountryIso
author: Identra
description: The ISO country code. Empty if not available.

name: SubscriptionInfo.getCardId
author: Identra
description: The card ID of the SIM card which contains the subscription.

name: SubscriptionInfo.getDisplayName
author: Identra
description: The name displayed to the user that identifies this subscription. This name is used in Settings page and can be renamed by the user.

name: SubscriptionInfo.getPortIndex
author: Identra
description: The port index of the SIM card which contains the subscription.

name: SubscriptionInfo.getSimSlotIndex
author: Identra
description: The index of the SIM slot that currently contains the subscription and not necessarily unique

name: SubscriptionInfo.getSubscriptionType
author: Identra
description: This method returns the type of a subscription

name: SubscriptionInfo.getUsageSetting
author: Identra
description: Get the usage setting for this subscription. USAGE_SETTING_UNKNOWN = -1

name: SubscriptionInfo.isEmbedded
author: Identra
description: true if the subscription is from eSIM.

name: SubscriptionInfo.isOpportunistic
author: Identra
description: An opportunistic subscription connects to a network that is limited in functionality and / or coverage.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimState
author: Identra
description: Returns a constant indicating the state of the default SIM card.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimState/slot
author: Identra
description: Returns a constant indicating the state of the device SIM card in a logical slot.

name: TelephonyManager.getDataState
author: Identra
description: Returns a constant indicating the current data connection state (cellular).

name: TelephonyManager.getNetworkCountryIso
author: Identra
description: Returns the ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code equivalent of the MCC (Mobile Country Code) of the current registered operator or the cell nearby, if available.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimCountryIso
author: Identra
description: Returns the ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code equivalent for the SIM provider's country code.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimOperator
author: Identra
description: Returns the MCC+MNC (mobile country code + mobile network code) of the provider of the SIM.

name: TelephonyManager.getNetworkOperatorName
author: Identra
description: Returns the alphabetic name of current registered operator.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimOperatorName
author: Identra
description: Returns the Service Provider Name (SPN).

name: TelephonyManager.getSimCarrierIdName
author: Identra
description: Returns carrier id name of the current subscription.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimSpecificCarrierIdName
author: Identra
description: Similar like getSimCarrierIdName(), returns user-facing name of the specific carrier id returned by getSimSpecificCarrierId().

name: TelephonyManager.getSubscriberId/slot
author: Identra
description: Returns the unique subscriber ID, for example, the IMSI for a GSM phone. Return null if it is unavailable.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimSpecificCarrierId
author: Identra
description: Returns fine-grained carrier ID of the current subscription.

name: TelephonyManager.getManufacturerCode
author: Identra
description: Returns the Manufacturer Code from the MEID. Return null if Manufacturer Code is not available.

name: TelephonyManager.getManufacturerCode/slot
author: Identra
description: eturns the Manufacturer Code from the MEID. Return null if Manufacturer Code is not available

name: TelephonyManager.getNai
author: Identra
description: Returns the Network Access Identifier (NAI). Return null if NAI is not available.

name: TelephonyManager.getMmsUAProfUrl
author: Identra
description: Returns the MMS user agent profile URL.

name: TelephonyManager.getMmsUserAgent
author: Identra
description: Returns the MMS user agent.

name: TelephonyManager.getGroupIdLevel1
author: Identra
description: Returns the Group Identifier Level1 for a GSM phone.

name: TelephonyManager.getNetworkSpecifier
author: Identra
description: Returns the network specifier of the subscription ID pinned to the TelephonyManager.

name: TelephonyManager.getNeighboringCellInfo
author: Identra
description: NA

name: TelephonyManager.getAllCellInfo
author: Identra
description: Requests all available cell information from all radios on the device including the camped/registered, serving, and neighboring cells.

name: SubscriptionManager.getActiveSubscriptionInfoList
author: Identra
description: Get the SubscriptionInfo(s) of all active subscriptions. Rebuilt from profile values: only slots configured in the profile are returned.

name: SubscriptionManager.getActiveSubscriptionInfo
author: Identra
description: Get the active SubscriptionInfo with the input subId. Returns null when the subscription's slot is not configured in the profile.

name: SubscriptionManager.getActiveSubscriptionInfoForSimSlotIndex
author: Identra
description: Get the active SubscriptionInfo associated with the slotIndex. Returns null when the slot is not configured in the profile.

name: TelephonyManager.getLine1Number
author: Identra
description: Returns the phone number string for line 1, for example, the MSISDN for a GSM phone for a particular subscription. Return null if it is unavailable.

name: TelephonyManager.getVoiceMailNumber
author: Identra
description: Returns the voice mail number. Return null if it is unavailable.

name: TelephonyManager.getSubscriberId
author: Identra
description: Returns the unique subscriber ID, for example, the IMSI for a GSM phone. Return null if it is unavailable.

name: TelephonyManager.getSimSerialNumber
author: Identra
description: Returns the serial number of the SIM, if applicable. Return null if it is unavailable.

name: TelephonyManager.getDeviceId
author: Identra
description: Returns the unique device ID, for example, the IMEI for GSM and the MEID or ESN for CDMA phones. Return null if device ID is not available.

name: TelephonyManager.getDeviceId/slot
author: Identra
description: Returns the unique device ID of a subscription, for example, the IMEI for GSM and the MEID for CDMA phones. Return null if device ID is not available.

name: TelephonyManager.getImei
author: Identra
description: Returns the IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity).

name: TelephonyManager.getImei/slot
author: Identra
description: Returns the IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity).

name: TelephonyManager.getMeid
author: Identra
description: Returns the MEID (Mobile Equipment Identifier).

name: TelephonyManager.getMeid/slot
author: Identra
description: Returns the MEID (Mobile Equipment Identifier).

name: TelephonyManager.getVoiceMailAlphaTag
author: Identra
description: Retrieves the alphabetic identifier associated with the voice mail number.

name: SubscriptionInfo.getIccId
author: Identra
description: Returns the ICC ID. Starting with API level 29 Security Patch 2021-04-05, returns the ICC ID if the calling app has been granted the READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE permission

name: SubscriptionInfo.createFromParcel
author: Identra
description: Rebuilds a SubscriptionInfo from a parcel; fields are overwritten from the profile values for the subscription's slot.
